baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive يُسْقَوْنَ, the content-bearing كَأْسًا, and مِزَاجُهَا anchor a recipient-facing act in which vessel, drink, and ginger admixture form one served unit.
baseline_models.mechanism: Giving drink transfers a cup together with what it contains, while mixing makes ginger constitutive of that content rather than an adjacent garnish. The temporal predication presents this composition as already established for the cup.

activation_trace.role: Giving a drink to a drinker supplies the recipient-facing transfer that begins the serving mechanism.
A cup together with its contents makes vessel and beverage a single delivered unit.
Temporal predication fixes the ginger composition as an established property of the cup.
Mixing one substance with another makes ginger an ingredient that constitutes the drink.

changed_reading.before: A cup is handed over and ginger is merely associated with it.
changed_reading.after: They receive a deliberately composed ginger-admixed drink whose vessel and contents function as one serving.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The Form-IV passive يُسْقَوْنَ and spatial فِيهَا can carry provision beyond a one-time handoff, while كَأْسًا gives that provision a finite personal endpoint.
baseline_models.mechanism: The watering branches permit a source or allotted water-share as well as direct drinking. The cup can therefore be the recipient-sized draw from an available channel of provision, not an isolated object appearing without supply.

activation_trace.role: Providing an accessible watering source expands the passive serving into durable availability.
An irrigation share and its channel supply the model of an allotted flow ending at the recipient.
The content-bearing cup bounds the larger provision as a concrete personal portion.

changed_reading.before: The verse depicts one detached cup being served once.
changed_reading.after: The cup is a personal allotment drawn from a continuing source of provision within the setting.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مِزَاجُهَا is grammatically the cup's admixture, but its branch inventory also opens bodily constitution; ingestion through يُسْقَوْنَ keeps that extension attached to the focus act.
baseline_models.mechanism: Because an admixture enters a drinker, the recipe can be read as constitutionally operative: ginger does not only flavor the liquid but tunes or alters the recipient's embodied state. This remains secondary to the direct beverage composition.

activation_trace.role: Bodily temperament and constitution turn the cup's admixture into a possible agent of embodied calibration.
Giving drink supplies the route by which the composed liquid can act upon its recipient.
Predicated being lets the recipe describe an established state that may answer another state.

changed_reading.before: Ginger contributes flavor or aroma to a beverage.
changed_reading.after: The ginger admixture may be a drink fitted to, or transforming, the drinker's embodied temperament.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first presents the human as a created mixed constitution whose condition is exposed by testing. That sequence strengthens the focus branch in which mizaj concerns constitution: the ginger mixture can answer or recompose a creature already introduced as mixture rather than merely decorate a drink.

activation_trace.role: Bodily constitution anchors the focus mixture as potentially fitted to the embodied recipient.
Ingestion provides the causal route from the cup's composition to the created person's condition.
Innate nature and interior disposition supply the human side of the constitution-to-constitution relation.
The mixed seminal origin presents the recipient as materially constituted through admixture from the outset.
Testing that reveals condition makes the created mixture a lived and disclosed state, not inert material.

structural_cues: 76:2 sequences mixed origin, testing, and made capacities of hearing and sight, linking composition to an operative human condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies created mixture, inward disposition, and condition-revealing testing; I supply the arrow that the later ingested mixture answers or retunes that constitution. The live alternative is the direct reading of mizaj as recipe only.

changed_reading.before: The bodily-temperament branch is an isolated lexical possibility in the focus.
changed_reading.after: The ginger drink can answer the surah's mixed, tested human constitution with a deliberately fitted recomposition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact cup-plus-predicated-admixture construction appears first with camphor and again in the focus with ginger, and each cup is followed by a spring. The focus cup therefore becomes the second member of a paired compositional-and-source architecture rather than a standalone luxury.

activation_trace.role: The cup with its contents supplies the repeated material unit in the focus.
Temporal predication supplies the repeated grammatical hinge between cup and ingredient.
Mixing supplies the focus member's ginger composition.
The earlier content-bearing cup establishes the first matching material unit.
The same predicative relation makes the parallel syntactically visible.
The earlier act of admixture gives the first cup its differentiating camphor composition.
A flowing-water source follows the first cup and supplies the first source endpoint of the pattern.
A second flowing-water source immediately follows the focus and closes the paired pattern.

structural_cues: 76:5-6 and 76:17-18 each form a cup whose admixture is named followed by a spring, with camphor and ginger differentiating the two units.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact grammatical repetition and two spring follow-ups; I infer deliberate pairing and possible staging. The materially live alternative is two parallel varieties with no sequence between them.

changed_reading.before: The ginger cup is an isolated composed serving.
changed_reading.after: The focus is the second cup-and-spring station in a deliberately paired provision system.

context_deltas.mechanism: Flowing sources and forceful release establish abundance, while the immediately preceding vessels are fitted to a measured limit. Together they turn the focus cup into the calibrated endpoint of abundant flow: supply is neither scarce nor shapeless, but proportioned to reception.

activation_trace.role: An available watering source supplies the infrastructure side of the focus serving.
A water-share and channel connect large supply to a bounded recipient portion.
The cup and its contents provide the finite endpoint into which the flow is metered.
A flowing spring supplies a continuing source rather than a detached vessel.
Wide splitting and release give the source forceful abundance and distributive reach.
Fitting a thing to its proper measure supplies calibration at the vessel end of the flow.
The spring after the focus confirms that its cup remains connected to a source.

structural_cues: The packet places gushing source language at 76:6, precisely measured vessels at 76:16, and another spring immediately after the focus at 76:18.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies springs, forceful outflow, measured vessels, and the cup; I connect them as source, distribution, and calibrated endpoint. They could instead be adjacent abundance images without a single hydraulic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The cup is merely one personal allotment from an unspecified supply.
changed_reading.after: It is a precisely fitted draw from abundant, actively distributed spring provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The people who feed vulnerable others while refusing compensation or thanks later occupy the passive recipient position of يُسْقَوْنَ. Recompense returns care without reducing the earlier gift to exchange: selfless providers become cared-for guests, and the cup is the social reversal made material.

activation_trace.role: Receiving drink places the former givers on the cared-for side of hospitality.
The cup with its contents makes returned care concrete and bodily.
Feeding another supplies the initiating act of outward hospitality.
The face standing for the divine self directs the feeding away from return by its human recipients.
Recognition and thanks are explicitly not sought, preventing a commercial reading of the later return.
An act answered by its recompense supplies the return path from giving care to receiving it.
The later recognition of their effort closes the reversal without making the needy its payers.

structural_cues: The agents of feeding in 76:8-9 become passive recipients of shelter, vessels, and drink in 76:11-21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies selfless feeding, refusal of human return, recompense, and later passive reception; I identify the drink as a reciprocal form of hospitality. The alternative is that the cup belongs only to an undifferentiated reward list.

changed_reading.before: The ginger cup is primarily an individual sensory reward.
changed_reading.after: It materializes a social reversal in which selfless feeders are themselves hosted and given drink.

context_deltas.mechanism: Nearby shade, lowered fruit, and vessels fitted to measure create an environment that adjusts itself to recipients. The focus mixture joins this accommodation: its ginger composition reads as selected and proportioned for the drinker, not as an arbitrary fixed recipe.

activation_trace.role: The content-bearing cup is the immediate service object that can be fitted to a recipient.
Constitutional mixture permits the ingredient to answer the recipient's embodied condition.
Nearness makes environmental provision approach the recipient rather than demand pursuit.
Making a difficult thing easy supplies the accommodation principle governing access to provision.
Matching a thing to its proper measure extends accommodation from reach to quantity and composition.

structural_cues: 76:14-16 moves from accessible shade and fruit to fitted vessels immediately before the focus cup.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies proximity, easing, exact fit, and the composed cup; I extend the same recipient-fit logic to the ginger admixture. The alternative is that only the vessel size, not the recipe, is customized.

changed_reading.before: The cup has a standard ginger recipe regardless of who receives it.
changed_reading.after: The ginger admixture participates in hospitality calibrated to the recipient's reach, measure, and constitution.

context_deltas.mechanism: The camphor-admixed cup and ginger-admixed focus cup sit in a setting that excludes both sun and severe cold. On the reader-supplied material association of camphor with cooling and ginger with warming, the focus cup becomes one pole of regulated thermal balance rather than flavor variety alone.

activation_trace.role: Mixing makes ginger an active component whose sensory tendency can be balanced against another admixture.
Bodily temperament provides the domain in which warming and cooling could be regulated.
The earlier mixed cup supplies the compositional counterpart to the focus drink.
Camphor as an aromatic substance identifies the contrasting material in the earlier mixture.
The sun supplies the excluded hot extreme of the surrounding climate.
Severe cold supplies the excluded cold extreme against which balanced mixtures can be read.

structural_cues: The two named admixtures occur within one reward scene whose environmental description explicitly negates opposed thermal extremes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies camphor, ginger, admixture, and the absence of sun and severe cold; I supply the ordinary material associations of camphor with cooling and ginger with warming and the balancing arrow. Aromatic or flavor contrast without thermal regulation remains fully live.

changed_reading.before: Ginger distinguishes this cup by taste or scent.
changed_reading.after: Ginger may supply the warming pole of a thermally balanced hospitality that excludes both environmental extremes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later clause repeats giving drink, names the Lord as agent, and describes a drink that purifies another. This resolves the focus's anonymous passive toward divine completion and places the ginger admixture within a progression that culminates in purification, rather than treating it as the final endpoint.

activation_trace.role: The anonymous passive giving of drink creates an open agent slot and an earlier stage of reception.
The ginger mixture marks the focus drink as composed, allowing contrast with a later purifying drink.
Repeated giving to drink links the later explicit clause back to the focus action.
Nurturing, repairing, and completing make the named Lord the fitting agent of the sequence's culmination.
Taking in liquid confirms that the later completion remains an ingested drink rather than an abstract purity.
A pure substance that purifies another supplies the transformative endpoint beyond the ginger composition.

structural_cues: After circulating vessels and attendants, 76:21 shifts to the explicit subject 'their Lord' for the final act of giving drink.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated watering, the later named agent, and a purifying drink; I infer agent continuity and staged completion. The alternative is that attendants serve the focus cup while the Lord's drink is a separate, non-sequential gift.

changed_reading.before: Unidentified servers give a ginger drink that completes the beverage scene.
changed_reading.after: The focus cup is an earlier composed stage in Lord-directed care that culminates in an explicitly purifying drink.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fulfilled commitment and patient restraint lead into the reward scene, while love of the immediate is later opposed to a heavy day. The established composition marked by كَانَ and the act of being given drink can therefore materialize deferred fulfillment: what was held for becomes present and ingestible.

activation_trace.role: Temporal predication presents the cup's composition as an established state now made present.
Actual receipt of drink turns deferred good into immediate bodily possession.
Completion without deficiency supplies the prior human posture that the reward answers.
Restraining the self from distress supplies the temporal endurance explicitly recompensed by the scene.
Haste and preference for what is advanced supply the rejected temporal alternative.
Heaviness supplies the deferred day's counterweight to immediate preference.

structural_cues: The focus lies inside the reward for patience begun at 76:12 and before the explicit immediate-versus-heavy-day contrast at 76:27.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fulfillment, patience, actual reception, and the critique of immediacy; I read the cup as a concrete conversion of delay into presence. The alternative is an atemporal item in a general reward inventory.

changed_reading.before: The ginger cup is an atemporal luxury within the scene.
changed_reading.after: It is deferred fulfillment made present, bounded, and bodily receivable for those who resisted the immediate.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because cloth-dyeing and grain-color branches are distant from the direct senses of drinking and admixture. It remains anchored in the focus watering and mixture roots, while the same reward scene supplies garments and green color as an outward counterpart. Downstream prose should present it only as an inward-saturation metaphor, never as a lexical replacement for 'given drink.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The combination of يُسْقَوْنَ and مِزَاجُهَا allows liquid uptake and compositional change to be imagined as saturation of the recipient.

activation_trace.role: Soaking cloth until it takes dye supplies a model of liquid penetrating and altering what receives it.
Grain changing color between green and yellow supplies visible transition as the effect of mixture.
Clothing, also able to stand for the self, supplies the outward covering paired with inward saturation.
Green coloration makes transformation of appearance explicit in the surrounding scene.

changed_reading.before: The drink passes into the recipient as consumable refreshment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the ginger mixture inwardly saturates and reclothes the recipient's constitution as dye saturates cloth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant س و ق target for the focus QAC root and must not displace the dominant watering analysis. It remains valid as a mapped branch activation sharpened by circulating attendants and fitted vessels. Downstream prose should qualify it as an ordered-motion resonance, not translate يُسْقَوْنَ as 'they are driven.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus passive on س ق ي is the mapped point where giving drink can acquire an exploratory undertone of impelled, successive movement.

activation_trace.role: Driving and impelling forward turns static service into directed movement through the scene.
Following one after another supplies ordered succession among servings or recipients.
Circulation around recipients supplies the moving service circuit for the vessels.
Fitting each thing to its measure keeps the moving sequence ordered and recipient-specific.
The attendants' continuing circuit reinforces movement as the service scene's operating form.

changed_reading.before: A stationary recipient is handed a stationary cup.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the focus is one measured step in an impelled, successive circuit of service.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the context occurrence of س ل س ل denotes punitive chains, while its inventory also contains smooth flow and drinking; the adjacent name Salsabil intensifies the formal echo without authorizing a new root citation. It remains anchored in the focus act of drinking and produces a visible reversal from binding to passage. Downstream prose should describe a cross-polar sound-and-branch activation, not claim that the chains themselves mean a drink.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's passive watering and content-bearing cup provide the positive drinking pole against which constriction can reverse into smooth passage.

activation_trace.role: Giving drink anchors the reversal in an actual act of refreshment and swallowing.
The cup with its liquid gives the smooth passage a concrete content and vessel.
Smoothness in flowing and drinking supplies the released positive potential inside the chain root.
Connected links supply serial continuity, which the focus can reverse from bondage into uninterrupted flow.
A collar binding the body supplies the constrictive state that smooth drinking counteracts.

changed_reading.before: The cup refreshes by satisfying thirst.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, its smooth passage reverses the surah's earlier linked constriction into released, continuous intake.

strongest_changes: Exact cup-admixture syntax plus paired spring follow-ups turns 76:17 into the second unit of a patterned provision architecture.
Gushing sources and fitted vessels strengthen the cup as a calibrated endpoint of abundant flow.
Selfless feeders becoming recipients of drink changes the cup into a non-commercial reversal of hospitality.
The later Lord-given purifying drink revises the ginger cup into an earlier stage of completing care.
The opening mixed human constitution makes the focus admixture potentially embodied and restorative, not flavor-only.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package exposed exact repetition, source-to-cup infrastructure, a giver-to-guest social reversal, later resolution of the passive agent, and several contained cross-domain activations that a local reading would likely collapse.
remaining_uncertainties: The paired cups may be sequential stages or parallel varieties without ordering.
The temperament and thermal-balance readings require reader-supplied material arrows beyond the direct grammar.
The focus passive may evoke attendant service even if 76:21 ultimately names the Lord as giver.
The dyeing, impelled-circuit, and chain-reversal outliers should remain exploratory resonances rather than lexical glosses.
